g.text: DERIVED-05

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: Cooling hardware size predicts its capacity, and so a site's power

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: rated cooling capacity against physical footprint for every unit in Epoch's two equipment catalogues. This

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: relationship is the measurement backbone of the whole dataset - it is what turns a rooftop counted in an aerial image into

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: a power figure.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Data Centers (CC-BY) — data_center_cooling_towers.csv + data_center_chillers.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-data-centers

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published data centers documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: BAC and SPX Cooling Technologies supply 74% of the 31 manufacturers catalogued, so this relationship is largely those two companies'

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: product lines; the interactive companion names the maker of every unit and colours the catalogue by it. Manufacturer catalogue

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: specifications, not measurements of installed units: rated capacity is an upper bound that real duty rarely reaches. 669 of 670

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: catalogue rows carry both a footprint and a capacity and are plotted; the rest are omitted rather than imputed. The dashed line is

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: the median intensity of 100 kW per m², a summary of central tendency and not a fitted model - the three equipment classes have

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: visibly different intensities, so applying one ratio to a mixed site introduces error. This is the step where most of the uncertainty

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: in the IT power figures originates.
